batch_selection: Measured FP32 BPTT: batch256=8.33GiB ~2537 samples/s; batch768=22.81GiB ~3241 samples/s. Adopt256 to retain100 optimizer steps/epoch (8000 total), rather than34/epoch at768, with conservative memory margin. No LR/architecture/labels/objective change.
checkpoint_selection: maximum validation path success, then maximum SPL, then minimum policy loss, then earlier epoch
halt_baseline: EMA of previous minibatch cost, beta=.95; detached action-independent scalar
halt_selection: no observed validation drop in overall or any Q1-Q4 success and SPL, and lower mean steps and actual batch1 latency; otherwise retain fixed16
